description: For a typical weekday and weekend day at this time of year (on a fixed-window or flat tariff, today's rates): the cheapest charge slot to fill a home battery before the 16:00 peak, an optional afternoon top-up, and what it saves a home using `usage` kWh a year – the battery runs the house after its charge until it's empty, through a typical day's use. No export, and not counting the battery's wear; with `solar_kwp`, also how full to charge overnight for the next day's sun.

battery_export.description: What the battery may export: `terms` (default) what the export tariff pays for – everything on Octopus's, only what the panels put in on the others; `all` what it charged from the grid too, on any export tariff – check the supplier pays for that; `solar` only what the panels put in, even on Octopus's; `never` – `evening_export` then says what that leaves. Without panels, give `export` too: everything a battery on its own exports came from the grid.

export.description: How export is paid: `paired` (the tariff's own export tariff, default), `fixed` (with export_rate), `fit` (the Feed-in Tariff's deemed export: paid whatever is exported, so the sun used at home gives nothing up), `none`, or an export tariff's key from list_tariffs?direction=export (used where the tariff can have it, else its own).

region.description: Agile region: a letter A-P or the slug from list_regions (eg `C` or `london`); list_regions lists well-known places in each.

solar_facing.description: The way they face: S, SE, SW, E, W, NE, NW or N – or a bearing in degrees (south is 180). Default S.

solar_inverter_kw.description: The inverter's limit, kW (0.5-50), if smaller than the panels.

solar_kwp.description: The home's solar panels, kWp (0.2-50): the answer then counts their forecast spare sun – see the docs' Solar panels section.

solar_pitch.description: Their angle from flat, degrees (0-90, default 35).

tariff.description: A tariff's key from list_tariffs (default `agile`), eg `go`, `edf-go-electric`, `eon-next-drive`.

usage.description: The home's electricity use, kWh a year (500-30000, default 2500 – an average home).

name: get_home_battery_times
title: Home battery charge times
